sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Commencing patrols, patrolling down Queen St.

Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham St, welfare checks on stores between Wyndham St and HQ, all clear, nothing to report. Maintaining our presence at the bottom of Wyndham St, standing by for any nearby response calls as well as on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving standby area, no issues have occurred.

Whilst patrolling down to Commercial Bay, welfare checked Macpac and they have reported a female has threatened to bring her brothers to wipe out the store after being denied service (photo provided). Standing by for security presence in case the female decides to return.
Response call from McDonald's Queen St / Unichem regarding homeless outside of their store.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen St / Unichem Queen St, informed vagrants that they had to move along, they complied, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining security presence (photo on file).

Whilst on standby, noticed a male getting ready to smoke legal substances in public. Informed him to conceal it, that smoking illegal substances in public is not allowed and that he has to move along; he complied with our orders. Standing by maintaining our security presence on upper Queen St (photo on file).
Leaving standby area, no issues have occurred.
